call_graph.dynamic_external_call_claim: No assertion about external unseen code; all named references in persistent Lua and disassembly inspected.

execution.A036_rank_gate: Action reads S.A036; recognizes ranks1..6 with factors2/2.5/3/3.5/4/5; all other ranks return before helper
execution.A035_rank_gate: Helper reads S.A035; rank<=0 returns multiplier1 without RNG. Ranks1..6 use listed thresholds. Rank>6 consumes one RNG but default threshold0/multiplier1 never crits.
execution.draw_order: One helper RNG after A036 valid-rank gate and A035 positive-rank gate. No re-roll or shared native critical result is read.
execution.probability_modifiers: No Game_Mode, A-item, target kind, nearby count, luck, illusion or other skill-probability modification in helper. A036_Action calls helper once before source-kind visual/illusion damage scaling.
execution.illusion_boundary: No local nonillusion exclusion; after the critical multiplier is chosen, source illusion scales extra damage by0.2. Natural illusion inheritance of A035/A036 is not established here.
execution.output_use: STR(S,true) * A036 factor * helper-returned multiplier; then possibleillusion0.2; separate UnitDamageTarget with false,false,HERO,NORMAL,WHOKNOWS. Recorded to delimit helper use, not full effect validation.
